entries.title: The crushing lameness of April Fools Day on the Internet.
entries.author: hoodoof
entries.current_title: The crushing lameness of April Fools Day on the Internet.
entries.excerpt: I have a sense of humor. Really I do. I just don't find being pounded with systematic absurdity for an entire day every year as being very funny. I don't know how to solve it. It seems every single company and publication that communicates via the web has a corporate communications department or something that thinks it's a corporate priority to come out with something for April Fools. The Internet systematizes, amplifies, focuses, fully resources, funds, schedules, plans and
entries.guide_zh: 作者厌倦互联网愚人节全天的刻意荒诞，质疑这些玩笑是否真好笑。

entries.title: Ask HN: CTO wants me to leave
entries.author: cantlookaway
entries.current_title: Ask HN: CTO wants me to leave
entries.excerpt: I'm the tech orientated founder (the other is the business guy), not the best coder but I understand my domain and know my abilities. We brought in a guy as CTO to help us move past problems we were having (feature creep, project management, enterprise level etc.). The guy has a lot of experience as CTO (I had very little, also little as a coder), and he was instrumental in getting us to the point of launch where we were enterprise grade ready (as opposed to hacker ready). entries.guide_zh: 后来加入的 CTO 希望技术创始人退出，作者求助如何面对团队冲突。

entries.title: Ask HN: What source code is worth studying?
entries.author: SatyajitSarangi
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What source code is worth studying?
entries.excerpt: This is one my favourite questions, asked by idlewords: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=879101 But its been a long time since then, and with a new set of programming languages, I believe there are new code bases that's worth studying about and learning from. So, which code-base should I be reading about to improve myself?
entries.guide_zh: 多年之后再征集值得研读的源码，希望发现新一批设计出色的项目。

entries.title: Ask HN: Idea Sunday
entries.author: rokhayakebe
entries.excerpt: A small HN experiment. Every Sunday, a thread will be started to share product ideas. Why? Because many people have ideas they will simply not have the time to implement, and many need product ideas to work on.
entries.guide_zh: 发起“点子星期天”，把暂时无暇实现的产品想法交给社区交流。

entries.title: An Update on HN Comments
entries.author: sama
entries.excerpt: Several people have mentioned to me that the comments on Hacker News seem much better recently, and asked me what changed. As far as I can tell, two of our experiments are working. The first is posting feedback in the threads about what's good and bad for HN comments. Right now, dang is the only one doing this, but other moderators may in the future. entries.guide_zh: 有人感觉 HN 评论近来改善，作者介绍自己观察到的变化与原因。

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (April 2014)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please lead with the location of the position and include the keywords INTERN, REMOTE, or VISA if the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome. Feel free to post any job that may interest HN readers from executive assistant to machine learning expert to CTO. Also see: Ask HN: Freelancer? Seeking freelancer? (April 2014) http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=7507753
entries.guide_zh: 四月招聘帖改用 VISA 标签，邀请公司标注地点、远程和相关支持。

entries.title: Ask HN: Your favorite YouTube channels?
entries.author: stevenspasbo
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Your favorite YouTube channels?
entries.excerpt: I've been on a YouTube kick lately, and would like some recommendations for your favorite technology/programming/whatever channels. I'm a java developer if that help. Here are some of mine: https://www.youtube.com/user/GoogleDevelopers https://www.youtube.com/user/GoogleTalksArchive https://www.youtube.com/user/AtGoogleTalks https://www.youtube.com/user/MarakanaTechTV As you can tell, they're almost all Google talks.
entries.guide_zh: 哪些 YouTube 频道最值得订阅，技术编程之外的有趣内容也欢迎。

entries.title: Ask HN: Do you have a side project you want to sell?
entries.author: gillis
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Do you have a side project you want to sell?
entries.excerpt: A thread similar to this was posted ~1 year ago by illdave. I think it's time for an updated 2014 version. If you have any side projects that you've built and that you no longer have time for, list them here and let's see if others want to buy it from you.
entries.guide_zh: 更新业余项目交易讨论，邀请愿意卖出自己作品的人介绍情况。

entries.title: Challenge HN: Keep lame April Fools' gags off the front page
entries.author: dang
entries.current_title: Challenge HN: Keep lame April Fools' gags off the front page
entries.excerpt: (I'm going to rewrite this, because people have made some good points in the thread.) Most April Fools' gags in tech are lame. Only the very best ones, such as those that show hackery ingenuity, deserve much attention on HN. I propose that we, or rather you, flag the others off the front page.
